selection.duplicate_policy: remove identical normalized gold SQL within each database
selection.sampling_note: sampling_complexity_score is a local stratification heuristic, not the official Spider hardness label

cases.question: what are all the addresses including line 1 and line 2?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT line_1 ,  line_2 FROM addresses

cases.question: How many departments offer any degree?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT department_id) FROM Degree_Programs

cases.question: Whose permanent address is different from his or her current address? List his or her first name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT first_name FROM Students WHERE current_address_id != permanent_address_id

cases.question: List the section_name in reversed lexicographical order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT section_name FROM Sections ORDER BY section_name DESC

cases.question: How many degrees does the engineering department offer?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Departments AS T1 JOIN Degree_Programs AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id WHERE T1.department_name  =  'engineer'

cases.question: When is the first transcript released? List the date and details.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT transcript_date ,  other_details FROM Transcripts ORDER BY transcript_date ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many times at most can a course enrollment result show in different transcripts? Also show the course enrollment id.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  student_course_id FROM Transcript_Contents GROUP BY student_course_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Find the kind of program which most number of students are enrolled in?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_summary_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Show the date and id of the transcript with at least 2 course results.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT T2.transcript_date ,  T1.transcript_id FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1 JOIN Transcripts AS T2 ON T1.transcript_id  =  T2.transcript_id GROUP BY T1.transcript_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

cases.question: Find the semester when both Master students and Bachelor students got enrolled in.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id WHERE degree_summary_name  =  'Master' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id WHERE degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'

cases.question: What are the arriving date and the departing date of all the dogs?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT date_arrived ,  date_departed FROM Dogs

cases.question: Which owners live in the state whose name contains the substring 'North'? List his first name, last name and email.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  last_name ,  email_address FROM Owners WHERE state LIKE '%North%'

cases.question: How much does the most expensive charge type costs?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT max(charge_amount) FROM Charges

cases.question: Which dogs have not cost their owner more than 1000 for treatment ? List the dog names .
cases.gold_sql: select name from dogs where dog_id not in ( select dog_id from treatments group by dog_id having sum(cost_of_treatment)  >  1000 )

cases.question: How many professionals did not operate any treatment on dogs?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Professionals WHERE professional_id NOT IN ( SELECT professional_id FROM Treatments )

cases.question: List pairs of the owner's first name and the dogs's name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T2.name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id

cases.question: List the names of the dogs of the rarest breed and the treatment dates of them.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  T2.date_of_treatment FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id  =  T2.dog_id WHERE T1.breed_code  =  ( SELECT breed_code FROM Dogs GROUP BY breed_code ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1 )

cases.question: Which first names are used for professionals or owners but are not used as dog names?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT first_name FROM Professionals UNION SELECT first_name FROM Owners EXCEPT SELECT name FROM Dogs

cases.question: What is the name of the breed with the most dogs?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT T1.breed_name FROM Breeds AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.breed_code  =  T2.breed_code GROUP BY T1.breed_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which owner has paid the largest amount of money in total for their dogs? Show the owner id and zip code.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.zip_code FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY sum(T3.cost_of_treatment) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many continents are there?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM CONTINENTS;

cases.question: What is the average horsepower of the cars before 1980?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT avg(horsepower) FROM CARS_DATA WHERE YEAR  <  1980;

cases.question: What is the smallest weight of the car produced with 8 cylinders on 1974 ?
cases.gold_sql: select min(weight) from cars_data where cylinders  =  8 and year  =  1974

cases.question: What is the average edispl of the cars of model volvo?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT avg(T2.edispl) FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T1.Model  =  'volvo';

cases.question: Find the make and production time of the cars that were produced in the earliest year?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Make ,  T1.Year FROM CARS_DATA AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.MakeId WHERE T1.Year  =  (SELECT min(YEAR) FROM CARS_DATA);

cases.question: How many car models are produced by each maker ? Only list the count and the maker full name .
cases.gold_sql: select count(*) ,  t2.fullname from model_list as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.maker  =  t2.id group by t2.id;

cases.question: Which model has the most version(make) of cars?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT Model FROM CAR_NAMES GROUP BY Model ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: How many car makers are there in each continents? List the continent name and the count.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.continent JOIN car_makers AS T3 ON T2.CountryId  =  T3.Country GROUP BY T1.Continent;

cases.question: What are the name of the countries where there is not a single car maker?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT CountryName FROM countries EXCEPT SELECT T1.CountryName FROM countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.countryId  =  T2.Country;

cases.question: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT T1.countryId ,  T1.CountryName FROM Countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country GROUP BY T1.countryId HAVING count(*)  >  3 UNION SELECT T1.countryId ,  T1.CountryName FROM Countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T3 ON T2.Id  =  T3.Maker WHERE T3.Model  =  'fiat';
